name: Misato (Shimane, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Misato town emblem in blue, green and red: a blue and green stylised running figure with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Misato, a town in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2004.

features.role: Misato town emblem — a blue and green stylised running figure with a red disc
